extraction_notes: Main-text performance figures digitised: Figures 9, 10, 13 and 14. Figures 11 and 12 are DRIFTS/TPD characterisation or probe-reaction plots and were skipped. Figures 1–8 are characterisation and were skipped. For Figure 9 time-on-stream plots, only first and last plotted points were recorded as requested. Figure 13/14 use PdZn particle size on the x-axis; this schema has no particle-size condition field, so the digitised x value is recorded in preparation/notes.
